Suhaila is also mentioned in the Quran as one of the names of Allah, and it is considered a name of great spiritual significance. In modern times, Suhaila has become a popular name among Muslims, and it is often given to girls who embody the qualities of beauty, kindness, and compassion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Suhaila is derived from the Arabic word "suhail", which means a bright star or a brilliant light. This name holds a rich cultural significance as the star Canopus represents guidance and protection for seafarers and sailors. In Arabic and Islamic culture, stars are believed to be the guardians of the sky and, thus, the protectors of the earth. The name Suhaila signifies the strength, resilience, and the unwavering guidance that a person may need to navigate through life's challenges.
data.spiritual_significance: Suhaila can also be interpreted as a symbol of divine guidance from Allah, represented by the bright and guiding star. In the Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah sends signs and guidance through various means, and the star Suhaila is a metaphorical representation of how Allah illuminates the path of His believers. The spiritual significance of the name Suhaila is one of hope, faith, and the reminder that even in the darkest of times, Allah's guidance can be found, just as the star Suhaila provides light and direction to those at sea.
